name: How often should I stain my wood siding in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How often should I stain my wood siding in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Bay Area, the frequency of siding staining depends on the type of stain used, exposure to sun and rain, and the wood species. Generally, transparent or semi-transparent stains may need reapplication every 2-5 years, while solid stains can last 5-10 years. Regular inspection for fading, peeling, or water absorption will help determine the best timing for re-staining.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frequency varies by stain type and weather exposure, typically every 2-10 years. Inspect for wear.
